real_defects.issue: parseClimate read a numeric month column ('1, 20, 75, 70, 35') as the outdoor temperature, shifting every column (outdoor RH read as 20%, indoor T as 75 F, indoor RH as 70%) with no error: the sample wall's peak went from 744 to 21,566 g/m². Months named out of order were silently relabelled, and single-space pastes were rejected. Fixed: a fifth leading value is the month (1-12), names are checked against the January-first order, extra values are refused, any whitespace separates.

The sample wall (DEFAULTS and the layers placeholder) listed latex paint after the gypsum, although layers are entered inside to outside, so the model placed the paint inside the wall. Base results unchanged (744 g/m², 17%), but a user swapping paint for polyethylene got poly on the room face. Fixed: paint first; the guide's poly case now places poly behind the drywall explicitly.

calculateBatch dropped a leading label only when it was non-numeric, so '1001, 25, 5, 10' (an order number) became price 1001, shipping 25, cost 5, and the real cost was silently dropped; five values were accepted with the extras ignored. Fixed: four values mean the first is a label; more than three values after the label are refused.

parseIssueValue filtered empty ';' parts before reading the issuer, so '0 issue "; accounturi=..."' (no issuer: no CA may issue, RFC 8659 4.2) was read as authorising a CA named 'accounturi=...' and nonWildcardDisallowAll was false. Fixed: read the issuer before dropping empty parts.
